title: Allsop (2004) Jetties — Scour around piles and scour-hole geometry
description: Scour calculation flowchart and diagrams of scour holes around vertical piles/cylinders under steady flow and live-bed conditions, with equilibrium scour depth relationships. | Figures: Figure 7.1 — Flowchart for scour calculations (after Whitehouse, 1998); Figure 7.2 — Scour around a pile due to steady flow from left to right: clear-water scour U/Ucr = 0.9; Figure 7.3 — Characteristic equilibrium scour hole pattern for a vertical cylinder; Figure 7.4 — Variation of scour depth with flow speed; Figure 7.6 — Scour development at a single pile in steady flow: variation of equilibrium scour depth with shear stress; Figure 7.7 — Correlation between equilibrium scour depth at circular pile and Keulegan-Carpenter number: live-bed conditions
